description: This file defines a class for managing a virtual platform target (FVP) in a testing environment, including state transitions, console setup, and command execution.

classes.name: OEFVPTargetState
classes.description: An enumeration representing the possible states of the FVP target (off, on, linux).

classes.name: OEFVPTarget
classes.description: A class for controlling and interacting with a FVP target, including starting, stopping, transitioning states, and setting up consoles.

methods.name: transition
methods.description: Handles transitioning the target to a specified state (off, on, linux).

methods.name: start
methods.description: Placeholder method for starting the target; no operation implemented.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Transitions the target to the OFF state.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a command on the target, ensuring it is in the linux state first.

methods.name: _setup_consoles
methods.description: Sets up console terminals based on the FVP configuration.

methods.name: _create_logfile
methods.description: Creates and manages log files for console output.

methods.name: __getattr__
methods.description: Dynamically exposes pexpect API methods for terminals.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Property that returns the current FVP configuration.
